checks.decodeOptions: -v error -xerror; video and optional audio mapped; stderr must be empty

audio.limits: RMS and peak of downmixed PCM are signal diagnostics, not LUFS, clipping proof, intelligibility or emotional-delivery scores.

intendedCues.text: At midnight, Maya received a message from her own number.
Four words: Don't open the door.
This time, it was a photograph.
The blue slipper she had just dropped.
Whoever sent it was already inside.

limits: Sample timestamps are requested seek positions, rounded to a decoded frame; not every-frame inspection.
Intended cues are source timing, not recognized speech, OCR or proof of a visible reveal.
Imported ASR can be wrong. English declaration is not independent language verification.
Keyword search retrieves text. No semantic model, generated answers or creative score runs.
No new media generation, API call or upload is performed.
